escena: SCENE (Run and Gun set, warehouse in Lima, late afternoon, NO recognisable faces): a hard low sun beam cuts across the concrete. Deep in the frame, a large azure-blue lighting panel is switched on and throws its cool blue across the far wall and the trusses — it is the blue of the house, present as a real working light. On the floor right at the lens, a strip of ORANGE gaffer tape marks a camera position, small but unmistakable against the grey concrete. A crew member steps over the lens at that instant. 16mm at f/4, camera on the ground. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the concrete floor itself, right at the lens, filling the bottom of the frame
lecho.tono: DARK grey concrete in shadow, matte
